technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend support suggest potential bounce, but price remains below all key moving averages with weak accumulation (negative CMF) and bearish MACD, making this a low-probability swing entry without confirmation of sustained upside.

fundamental.summary: GM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 28 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling by junior member and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 28 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9) with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend support near 33.24 creates technical bounce setup in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry for short-term mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative CMF (weak accumulation), bearish MACD, inverted yield curve recession signal, earnings binary risk in 28 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a low-probability swing trade with severe macro headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and stochastic bullish cross offer technical bounce setup, but price remains structurally below all major moving averages with negative accumulation (CMF) and bearish MACD, signaling weak conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve recession signal combined with VIX crisis levels and earnings binary event in 28 days create severe macro headwinds that outweigh technical bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see bounce setup; fundamental and risk agents strongly reject due to macro environment and earnings proximity
decision.portfolio_note: Already 23 positions in Consumer Discretionary sector; adding GM increases concentration risk without fundamental or smart money support.
